items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I know him for everybody. Yeah, that's the only name I ever know is Buttsy.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, did he die, or?

I don't know if Son's dead. I mean, I don't think Buttsy's dead, but I believe Son's dead. But, uh, nobody wrote and told me about him being dead. And I asked about Buttsy. Oh, Buttsy's son is dead. Yeah. I asked about Buttsy, but Buttsy ain't dead. Him.
